generator_rules.carry_and_carry_unaligned: A=R(block_cycle[block]*channel_scale[channel]), block_cycle=[.125,.25,.0625,.5,0,.25], channel_scale=[1,.5,.25,.125,.0625,.75]. One impulse at i=(13*block+7*channel+frame)%256: value=-A if(block+channel)odd else+A; all other samples+0.
generator_rules.lfe_only: Channels0..4 all+0; channel5 every sample=cycle[block], cycle=[0,.125,.5,.75,.25,0].
generator_rules.weighted: A=R(channel_scale[channel]*block_cycle[block]), channel_scale=[.015625,.03125,.0625,.125,.25,.75], block_cycle=[1,.5,2,0,1.5,.25]. sample[i]=R(A*unit[(i+channel+block)%5]), unit=[0,1,-1,.5,-.5]. Multiplication by0 preserves signed zero.
generator_rules.ties: A=(channel+1)/32. Only i0,4,128,252,255 are nonzero; i4/255=-A, others+A. All others+0.
generator_rules.signed_zero: Use-0 exactly when channel1, or channel2 and iodd, or channel3 and i255, or channel4 and i0, or channel5 and i!=255; otherwise+0.
generator_rules.q15_ties: A=(2*channel+block+0.5)/65536. One signed impulse at(13*block+7*channel+frame)%256, negative for(block+channel)odd, else positive; other samples+0.
generator_rules.zero_permutations: Every sample+0 except i=positions[block] is-0, positions=[251,255,254,255,0,255]. This provides same-lane251/255 and cross-lane254/255 ordered comparisons on the samechannel acrossblocks.
generator_rules.alignment: ALIGNED profile uses16-byte-aligned sample storage. carry_unaligned uses4-mod16 storage; alignment_offset8 cases use8-mod16. Arithmetic profile is explicit in recipe, not inferred from kind in a public API.

external_delayed_six_bridge: For a synthetic frame-major6x1536 external buffer, native channel c maps to external slot[0,2,1,4,5,3][c], then sample index=slot*1536+block*256+i. This layout bridge reuses the approved input contract; no real PCM/ADM is delivered.
